auditFindings: The upstream recent-search capacity is 25; an initially guessed value of 20 was corrected from final production code before calibration.

The first semantic observer was coupled to official class names and undercounted equivalent Android implementations; implementation-tolerant evidence branches were added without changing expected states.
The ArkTS recent-search candidate defined a file-backed store but injected an in-memory store in the production page. The persistence case now requires production wiring and correctly fails.
The ArkTS recent-search candidate selects the messages target instead of rooms when a saved query is chosen; the canonical selection transition correctly fails.
Task 06 is valid but MiniMax-M3 completes all nine cases on both platforms, so it is flagged as easier rather than treated as proof of stronger benchmark discrimination.
